---
format: docx
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("hooks.R")
chain_hook("plot", after = function(res, options) {
  field <- "`<w:r><w:fldChar w:fldCharType=\"begin\" w:dirty=\"true\"/></w:r><w:r><w:instrText xml:space=\"preserve\"> SEQ Figure \\* Arabic </w:instrText></w:r><w:r><w:fldChar w:fldCharType=\"end\"/></w:r>`{=openxml}"
  sub("(!\\[[^]]*)\\]\\(", paste0("\\1 ", gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", field), "](" ), res)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-a
#| fig-cap: "CAP-A"
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: "CAP-B"
plot(3:1)
```

See @fig-a and @fig-b.
